title: How to enter a purchase invoice
subtitle: For any supplier — copy the numbers as printed; PetroMath works out the rest.

steps.text: Quantity: the number of pieces you received. If the invoice shows litres, choose Litres and PetroMath converts.
Amount: the line amount before discount and GST.
Discount: the discount for that line, if any.
Cash discount: a discount given on the whole bill, if any.
Printed total: the bill total. You can close the invoice only when it matches.

hints.gross: Line amount before discount and GST
hints.cash_discount: Discount on the whole bill, if any
hints.tax_type: IGST only if the supplier is in another state
